exposure: adnexal mass detected incidentally during cesarean section
cohort: The study included 111 patients who delivered by cesarean section between January 2015 and February 2020, where an adnexal mass was detected incidentally during the procedure.
finding: Among 3700 cesarean deliveries, an adnexal mass was incidentally detected in 111 (3%) patients, with 110 undergoing cyst excision and 1 oophorectomy, and malignancy reported in 0.9% of cases; masses above 5 cm are concluded to require removal due to malignancy risk.
